drafted_from: workflow:route-each-row-change's own file, tools/workflows/recipes/route-each-row-change.json (its wake, definition and steps), and its run on the workflow engine with stand-in answers on 2026-11-18
start_here: Say to your AI: "Turn on workflow:route-each-row-change's wake a-row-changed, and attach record_row_change() to my lesson_request table." From then on, each row added to lesson_request is read once and every workflow whose conditions follow that change (here the explainer-video workflow, from its step plan-the-lesson) is told to start under its own switch.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing: it reads one change from the person's own row_changes table, which record_row_change() fills, and tells facts to the engine; every row it reads is already the person's.
instructions: 1. Make the person's database with workflow:make-a-database-for-each-pursuit; it makes row_changes and the record_row_change() trigger function, and keeps the connection under a vault name.

2. Attach record_row_change() to each table whose changes should start work: CREATE TRIGGER lesson_request_changes AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON lesson_request FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION record_row_change().
3. Turn on tool:notice-when-something-shows-up's wake keep-noticing-row-changes with that vault name, and this workflow's wake a-row-changed.

4. Give a workflow a fires_when condition over the change's table_name and op (fields of kind choice, rule is_any_of) and, in its input, the step it starts at; turn on that workflow's own workflow-chosen wake.
5. Add a row and read the run of this workflow: it reads the change, names the workflows chosen, and tells each one; each chosen workflow then runs from its own wake.

worked_examples.title: A lesson request added starts the explainer-video workflow at plan-the-lesson
worked_examples.ask: I just added a lesson request for a video about tides; start whatever should follow it.
worked_examples.given: The noticer told row-changes {database p_x, table_name lesson_request, op INSERT, position 42, connection watched-database-connection}; read-the-change read the row at position 42 ({"id":7,"topic":"tides"}), and the chooser kept that part with the explainer-video workflow's condition "a lesson_request row is added".
worked_examples.hands_back: One wake:arrive of kind workflow-chosen with event_id "p_x:901:42:workflow:make-a-personalised-explainer-video-on-any-topic-for-a-learner:a lesson_request row is added" and payload {"workflow":"workflow:make-a-personalised-explainer-video-on-any-topic-for-a-learner","condition":"a lesson_request row is added","database":"p_x","table_name":"lesson_request","op":"INSERT","position":"42","connection":"watched-database-connection"}; that workflow's own wake then starts it at plan-the-lesson.
